name: Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh Lạng Sơn (Lang Son Province Integrated Data Center)
developer: UBND tỉnh Lạng Sơn / provincial IT center
notes: Official provincial plan (Kế hoạch 135/KH-UBND 2019 on IT application 2020) requires maintaining and operating the technical infrastructure at the province integrated data center (Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh) to keep shared government information systems running. Confirms a small public-sector provincial data center exists/operates; no MW, racks or address disclosed; legal-database reproduction of official document (B/C). Not commercial colocation.

name: Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh Quảng Ninh (Quang Ninh Province Integrated Data Center, QNICT)
developer: Sở Thông tin và Truyền thông tỉnh Quảng Ninh / QNICT (Quang Ninh ICT Center)
notes: Official QNICT page: the Quang Ninh province integrated data center (project component of the e-Government scheme approved by Decision 2459/QD-UBND dated 28/9/2012) was built to Tier 3 / TIA-942 standard and has operated stably since Q4/2014; on 24/01/2018 the MIC Telecommunications Department recognized its standards compliance (Notice 549/CVT-CL, second provincial center in Vietnam after Dong Nai). VietnamNet reports FPT-deployed shared government applications hosted there. Public-sector facility; capacity in MW not disclosed; separate from commercial colo/hyperscale.

name: Trung tâm Dữ liệu tỉnh Thanh Hóa (Thanh Hoa Province Data Center - overall investment/upgrade project)
developer: UBND tỉnh Thanh Hóa / Sở Khoa học và Công nghệ (provincial government)
notes: Thanh Hoa Department of Science and Technology homepage carries a procurement request for equipment for the project 'Đầu tư, nâng cấp tổng thể Trung tâm Dữ liệu' (Investment, overall upgrade of the Data Center), indicating an existing provincial data center being upgraded/expanded (equipment quotation stage). No MW/racks/address disclosed in snippet; official portal evidence is C (homepage snippet, no dedicated facility page verified). Provincial public-sector facility, not commercial colo.

name: Nghệ An Province Data Strategy to 2030 (data-infrastructure plan)
notes: Decision 2799/QD-UBND dated 25/6/2026 approves Nghe An's Data Strategy to 2030, positioning data as a strategic resource and digital-government foundation. Policy/strategy lead only: no facility-level datacenter project, IRC, or construction evidence found in Nghe An (WHA/VSIP industrial zones present but no announced DC). Monitor for follow-on data-center investment; not yet a physical project.

name: Vũng Áng Data Center (PV GAS + Nebula Energy + Ha Tinh EZ Board cooperation)
developer: Ban Quản lý Khu kinh tế tỉnh Hà Tĩnh / PV GAS (Petrovietnam) / Nebula Energy
notes: Bao Dau Thu (investment trade press) 2026-07-31: within the Petrovietnam-Ha Tinh strategic cooperation on the Vung Ang energy-industrial center, a cooperation agreement was signed to study the investment opportunity for a Data Center between the Ha Tinh Economic Zone Management Board, PV GAS and Nebula Energy. Agreement/feasibility-study stage only - announced/planned; no IRC, land, MW or construction evidence yet. Vung Ang is Ha Tinh's energy/industrial economic zone.
